additional_concerns: The packet establishes continuing responsibility, but supplies neither a complete test of effective retention nor facts establishing satisfaction. Practical authority and supervisory conduct are potential evidence, not source-established necessary or sufficient conditions.

Defective records may breach the substantive record-keeping duty without proving that accountability was transferred. Conversely, retained accountability does not establish sound operations or proper records.
Section 6.11C supplies a valuation-specific standard; importing it as a tokenisation supervision safe harbour or universal requirement would require additional support.

Paragraph 14 distinguishes confirmation from demonstration upon request. Footnote 5 can elaborate that request-conditioned demonstration or suggest an independent demonstration expectation; the supplied text does not conclusively resolve those readings. Absence of a request does not extinguish underlying responsibilities or the confirmation expectation.

Paragraphs 15 and 16 separately condition procurement of audit or verification and legal opinion on SFC request. Neither procurement nor absence of a request establishes retained accountability or substantive compliance.

Intermediary paragraph 18 adds understanding and satisfaction with ownership and technology controls before relevant activities. Its role conditions and the missing Appendix Parts A and B must be considered before using it to assess this Product Provider.
No executable meaning is supplied. Retrieval success and the unsupported LegalRuleML result establish no legal sufficiency or executable fidelity.
